solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Entertainment centre just by stadium

parts.note: just means fair, as in a just or fair decision
a stadium is a sports ground

explanation.surface: An amusement venue set up right next to a sports stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: A site with rides and sideshows is a place people go for amusement, a centre of entertainment.

clue.text: Set out with a compass, crossing top of ridge

indicators.note: crossing says the compass piece goes across, round the next letter

parts.note: compass means range or scope

indicators.note: top of in a down clue picks the first letter of ridge

explanation.surface: A hiker sets off with a compass over a ridge's crest.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay things out in order is to arrange them.

clue.text: Swindle man on board

definitions.meaning: a chess piece, also called a castle

explanation.surface: Cheat a fellow on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To rook is to cheat; it is also a chessman, a piece on the board.

clue.text: £10 brought up for cheesemaker

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tenner is a ten-pound note

explanation.surface: Ten pounds paid for someone who makes cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheesemaker' looks like a person but is the enzyme used to curdle milk.
explanation.definitionFit: This enzyme from calves' stomachs curdles milk, so it literally makes cheese.

clue.text: Not appropriate, units due to be changed

indicators.note: letters that are changed are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Military units are about to be reassigned because they are unfit.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ill-matched or unfit for a purpose is not appropriate.

clue.text: Monotonous speaker, doctor on energy

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A dull lecturer: a doctor holding forth about energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A bore who talks in a flat, droning voice is a monotonous speaker.

clue.text: Predicament consuming terribly wary dramatist

indicators.note: consuming says the predicament swallows the next piece

parts.note: a plight is a predicament

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters of wary are jumbled

explanation.surface: A writer of plays is anxious about a difficult situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wary' looks like a description of the dramatist's mood, but 'terribly' marks it as letters to shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of stage plays is a dramatist.

clue.text: Humorous drawing of box containing nothing

indicators.note: containing says the box holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: a carton is a cardboard box
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A comic sketch of an empty box.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic strip or newspaper sketch meant to amuse is a funny picture.

clue.text: My old country's royal event

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
a country is a nation

explanation.surface: An exile recalls a royal occasion in their former homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' looks possessive but is the exclamation, cor being a British exclamation like 'gosh'.
explanation.definitionFit: The crowning of a monarch is a ceremonial state occasion.

clue.text: Hood following sheriff's lead may make one frown

indicators.note: following places the hood after the sheriff's letter
a word's lead is its leading, first letter

parts.note: a cowl is a monk's hood

explanation.surface: Robin Hood's tale: following the Sheriff of Nottingham's example could make anyone glower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hood' tempts towards Robin Hood and the sheriff, but it is just a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To glower with a furrowed brow and an angry look is to frown.

clue.text: Stinking row

definitions.meaning: a line or tier, as in the ... of soldiers

explanation.surface: A smelly quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both foul-smelling and a line of people or things, as in rank and file.

clue.text: Shipment greatly required by food shop

indicators.note: required by places the word for greatly after the food shop's word

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen, a food shop
greatly means very

explanation.surface: A grocery desperately needs its consignment of goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A consignment of goods brought to a customer is a shipment.

clue.text: Everyone at home welcoming a church wedding

parts.note: everyone means all

indicators.note: welcoming says the word for at home takes the next piece inside

parts.note: in means at home
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: The whole family at home receiving a church marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A union or marriage between two parties is an alliance, so wedding fits in a figurative sense.

clue.text: Goad pointer

definitions.meaning: the indicator on a dial or compass

explanation.surface: A prod or a stick used to point.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle is to provoke; a needle is also the moving indicator on a gauge.

clue.text: Put right about couple

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: Settle things concerning a married couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To mend or fix something is to put it right.

clue.text: Stupid in the way that number must cross island

indicators.note: must cross says the pieces straddle the island letter

parts.note: as means in the way that
nine is a number

explanation.surface: A ship's route made foolish by having to cross an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Silly or foolish behaviour, like a donkey's, is stupid.

clue.text: Bright in bar after opening of curtains

indicators.note: after puts the bar's word behind the curtains' letter
opening of picks the first letter of curtains

parts.note: a lever is a bar used to prise

explanation.surface: Sunlight in a pub once the curtains are drawn back.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright pupil is a quick, intelligent one.

clue.text: Substantial list includes North American soldier

indicators.note: includes says the list takes the next pieces inside it

parts.note: a table is a list of figures
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A long roster that names a US serviceman.
explanation.definitionFit: Something real and solid enough to touch is substantial, as with tangible evidence.

clue.text: Dark wicked thing

indicators.note: wicked suggests the letters behave badly and are scrambled

explanation.surface: A sinister, evil creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The time after sunset is the dark, used as a noun.

clue.text: Call outfit around noon, initially

indicators.note: around says the outfit goes round the next letter

parts.note: a rig, or rig-out, is an outfit of clothes

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of noon

explanation.surface: Phone the clothes supplier at about midday.
explanation.definitionFit: To phone someone is to call them; giving someone a ring is British for a phone call.

clue.text: Song from Callas, not her first

indicators.note: not her first means the first letter of her name is dropped

parts.note: Maria Callas was a famous opera soprano

explanation.surface: A piece sung by Callas other than her debut.
explanation.definitionFit: A solo song in an opera is an aria.

clue.text: Mouthpiece for musical instrument

definitions.meaning: a newspaper or journal speaking for a party or group

explanation.surface: Asking for the part you blow into on an instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A party's newspaper is its official voice; the word also names the church keyboard instrument with pipes.

clue.text: Italian composer ahead of court ruling

indicators.note: ahead of places the composer before the court's abbreviation

parts.note: Giuseppe Verdi was an Italian opera composer

explanation.surface: Verdi arrives ahead of a judge's decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court ruling' reads as one phrase, but 'court' gives CT and only 'ruling' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A jury's decision or judgement is a ruling.

clue.text: What may decide winner of cup, about right after draw

indicators.note: after puts the cup with its insertion behind the draw

parts.note: a tie is a draw in a match

indicators.note: about says the cup goes round the letter for right

parts.note: a beaker is a drinking cup

explanation.surface: In a cup match, a drawn game may be settled by an extra contest.
explanation.definitionFit: An extra game or point played to settle a level score decides who the winner is.
